items.defectStatement: A nonempty totpCode skips password verification, but the backup-code branch takes precedence and never validates that TOTP value. Supplying an email, a valid backup code, and a dummy totpCode therefore authenticates without the account password.
obligations: Prevent a request containing both backupCode and totpCode from authenticating without password verification.
Reject invalid authentication before consuming a backup code.
Preserve password-authenticated backup-code login and consumption of the accepted code.
Preserve the existing TOTP-only validation path.
items.notes: Rejecting simultaneous factor inputs fixes the bypass entirely within the anchor. Alternatively, require successful password verification in the backup-code branch, including when totpCode is supplied; reject missing stored passwords in that verification path.
